fee_notes: Monthly Service Fee is 10% of gross sales, due 10th of month. Minimum annual royalty of $8,000 applies to Small Format with <$80k annual sales (~$667/month). Tiered rates: 7% stadium/arena, 9% airports/tollways. Marketing Fee is $1,500 annually (~$125/month), billed December. Additional event-based fees include transfer ($500), voluntary termination ($10k-$15k), audit, late charges, etc.
raw_excerpt: Monthly Service Fee: 10% of Gross Sales except (a) 7% stadium/arena, (b) 9% airports/tollways, (c) minimum annual aggregate $8,000 for Small Format <$80k sales. Marketing Fee: $1,500 Annually.
